<!-- pr-reviewer: 79617263e3237d45d285ad8bbe4a2019c60d81da -->
Needs changes before merge. Set `needs-rework`.

This is the first review. I read the whole diff and checked the current laws from `upstream/main:AGENTS.md`.
This is a SAFETY-tier review because the change affects part collision findings.

What passed:

- All three part-solid producers name the part and move. The stock producer keeps its message.
- The new kind blocks the post. MCP keeps its kind, message, move, and blocking state.
- The UI warning tests pass. Part and stock findings keep separate groups and move locations.
- No recorded programs, catalog files, fixtures, or goldens changed. There are no moved goldens to inspect.

Local build and test results:

The trial merge is `5488c0e58e2e0d930cfa561ea6fadcecd6e0f0ea`.
Its first parent is this PR head. Its second parent is `upstream/main` at `44903e15e0f44f159858ae813e534710c82b7952`.
All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3777`. No GitHub runner ran.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 411 steps; 2 failed; 0 stalled. Test totals: 4,724 passed, 8 failed, 45 ignored. |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps; 0 failed; 0 stalled. |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | 98 steps; 0 failed; 0 stalled. Seven kernel steps were not reached. |
| Clippy, all targets, warnings denied | Passed for `camcraft-sim`, `camcraft-app`, `camcraft-ui`, and `camcraft-motion`. |
| `rapid_part_message` | All 4 tests passed. |

heavy lanes green on 79617263e3237d45d285ad8bbe4a2019c60d81da against upstream/main 44903e15e0f44f159858ae813e534710c82b7952, completed 2026-11-24 UTC: 98 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled.
The heavy gate checked four existing expected failures: three for #1950 and one for #2849.
Each failed at its expected assertion. No unexpected heavy failure occurred.

Extra suites run:

- App `example_catalog`: 39 passed, 4 ignored.
- App `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- App `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- App `first_part_programs`: 2 passed.
- App `first_router_part`: 4 passed.
- App `solid_law_goldens`: 7 passed.
- App heavy `example_catalog` and `flute_reach`: passed.

The quick gate ran each named debug suite above. The diff changes no fixture or importer, so the extra kernel import rule does not apply.

Mutations run by this reviewer:

I reverted each producer to `RapidInStock` separately. I restored the source after each check.

| Producer in `crates/sim/src/verify/solid.rs` | Pin | Mutation / restored |
|---|---|---|
| Stopped fine-bore body, line 220 | `a_stopped_fine_bore_holder_rapid_names_the_part_and_move` | Red / green |
| Retract edge column, line 231 | `a_stack_retract_edge_column_names_the_part_and_move` | Red / green |
| General rapid, line 236 | `a_vertical_part_rapid_names_the_part_and_move` | Red / green |

Each mutation failed on the wrong diagnostic text. Each restored test passed. The source tree is clean.

Requested before merge:

1. **Failed assertion — `crates/app/tests/rotary_verify.rs:348`.** `a_rough_over_an_oversized_bar_peels_from_the_stock_radius` fails on the trial merge. The matching bar produces 2,110 moves; the test expects 2,064. Check the intended motion against current main. Correct the behavior or justify and update the pin. Run the whole `rotary_verify` suite again. This review does not establish that this PR introduced the failure.

   ```text
   assertion `left == right` failed: the matching bar has no air level - its ladder must not move
     left: 2110
    right: 2064
   ```

2. **Test evidence — `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs:1989` and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/report_tests.rs:26`.** The UI library step is red. Six report tests fail with `No adapter found`. `headless_run_succeeds` also fails because no graphics adapter is available. The suite has 1,527 passed, 7 failed, and 8 ignored. This is an environment limit, not an established code defect. Provide a green local UI library result for this head on a host with a working adapter. Keep every required test in the run. Under the requested all-green rule, this red step cannot count as ready.

3. **UI evidence — `crates/ui/src/operations.rs:274`.** The PR changes visible diagnostic text and grouping. The body has no before/after screenshots and states that none ran. Add linked images that show the old and new diagnostics, including separate part and stock groups. Store PR images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Do not add images to the PR branch.

4. **Test placement — `crates/sim/tests/rapid_part_message.rs:1`.** This adds a top-level integration test binary. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, “New tests join a directory suite,” requires a one-line reason in the PR body. The body has no reason. Add that reason, or place these tests in an existing domain directory suite.

The PR is mergeable, but these items prevent `merge-ready`. The PR stays a draft.
The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build warm.
No code, image, log, or review evidence was committed or pushed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: findings 2–4. Finding 1 is verified locally but held, not pushed.

1. Rotary pin: the held fix checks the maximum Feed radius of 6.2 mm. The old pin fails with upstream seam routing: 2,110 versus 2,064 moves. The semantic pin passes all 10 `rotary_verify` tests. A wrong-stock mutation fails at 6.000000 versus 6.2 mm. Restoration passes all 10 tests.
2. UI library: SwiftShader Vulkan gives 1,525 passed, 0 failed, 8 ignored, 0 filtered. All required tests run. The body explains the temporary backend configuration and its restoration.
3. Screenshots: the body links immutable before/after images on the fork's images-only branch. The actual banner shows separate stock and part groups. These are regression fixture renders.
4. Test placement: the body gives the reason for the separate `rapid_part_message` binary.

RESULT: STOPPED. The same-logic conflict prevents a push.
The hunk is in `crates/app/tests/rotary_verify.rs`, in `a_rough_over_an_oversized_bar_peels_from_the_stock_radius`.
Held local assertion: maximum Feed radius is 6.2 mm within `1e-6`.
Main assertion: `assert_eq!(snug, 2110, ...)`.
Upstream commit: `473600714d1e3af9a9332bf2c9774882a956ba24`.
That commit is already in the gate-start base. No conflict resolution is applied.

Held local head: `bac5144a9447f2d60ebcdb7276c4f29e7de1663e`.
Remote PR head: `79617263e3237d45d285ad8bbe4a2019c60d81da`, unchanged.
All final tests cover the held local head against gate-start base `db3bb1f7f3c47cf3561a8e9534f4f2cde260cba8`.
Quick: 411 steps green across the run and retries; 4,716 passed, 0 failed, 45 ignored.
Heavy: 96 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled; four expected failures and seven kernel steps not reached.
Clippy passes for all four touched crates. Catalog and reached golden suites pass. No goldens move.
Latest main `29bb9e9a2048d59ec44d2ec8a52b2e5687822ff6` receives only a read-only merge check. No gate-equivalence proof is completed.

Please re-review the current PR head against current main and the linked UI evidence. The local rotary pin remains held.

Addressed: the four findings of the review on `79617263e`. The new head is `e1bbe8583f9a867d8465f69c00dff93894a726eb`.

1. **`rotary_verify.rs:348` (2,110 moves, not 2,064).** This PR did not cause the failure. PR #3496 changed the count on `main`, and `main` was red (#3774). Commit `473600714` on `main` set the pin to 2,110. I merged `upstream/main` (`db3bb1f7f`) into the branch with a merge commit and no hand edits. Evidence: `app suites: rotary_verify` has 10 passed and 0 failed on the new head. `a_rough_over_an_oversized_bar_peels_from_the_stock_radius` passes. Issue #3794 tracks the replacement of the bare count.

2. **UI library evidence.** I ran the quick gate on a macOS host with a working graphics adapter. Evidence: `ui lib` has 1,537 passed, 0 failed and 8 ignored. `headless_run_succeeds` and the six report tests passed. No test was removed from the run.

3. **Before/after screenshots.** The PR body now links the two images. They show one group before, and separate stock and part groups after. The images are on the `pr-screenshots` branch of the fork at commit `e0928e6c1`. No image is on the PR branch.

4. **Test placement.** The top-level binary `crates/sim/tests/rapid_part_message.rs` is removed. The four tests are now the module `part_message` of the existing binary `crates/sim/tests/posed_rapids.rs`. `crates/sim/tests/` has no directory suite, thus an existing binary is the nearest home. The test count and the assertions did not change. Evidence: `sim suites: posed_rapids` has 9 passed. Mutation check after the move: each of the three producers in `solid.rs` (lines 220, 231, 236), reverted to `RapidInStock`, made its pin fail. Each pin passed after the restore.

Gates on the new head:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 411 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` | 99 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled; four known fails (#1950, #2849) red as expected |
| Clippy, all targets, warnings denied, four touched crates | passed |

`upstream/main` moved to `29bb9e9a2` (PR #3797) during the gates. The head merges cleanly with it.

The PR stays a draft. Please review the new head again.

<!-- pr-reviewer: e1bbe8583f9a867d8465f69c00dff93894a726eb -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. Set `merge-ready`.

This is a re-review. The earlier review was on head `79617263e` and had four findings.
This is a SAFETY-tier review because the change touches the findings of the part collision law.
I read the laws from `upstream/main:AGENTS.md`.

## Earlier findings

| # | Finding | State |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `crates/app/tests/rotary_verify.rs:348` failed on the trial merge (2,110 moves, not 2,064). | Fixed. The branch has a merge of `upstream/main` that contains commit `473600714`. `app suites: rotary_verify` is green on this head. This PR does not change that file. |
| 2 | The UI library step was red (no graphics adapter). | Fixed. `ui suites: lib` is green in my quick gate on this head. No test was removed. |
| 3 | The body had no before/after screenshots. | Fixed. The body links `before.png` and `after.png` at commit `e0928e6c1` of the `pr-screenshots` branch of the fork. I opened the two images. "Before" shows one stock group with "repeated on 2 more moves (to 6)". "After" shows the stock line for move 3 and the part line for move 4, "repeated on 1 more move (to 6)". No image is on the PR branch. |
| 4 | A new top-level test binary had no reason in the body. | Fixed. Commit `e1bbe8583` moves the four tests into the module `part_message` of the existing binary `crates/sim/tests/posed_rapids.rs`. The body has a "Test placement" section. The test count and the assertions are the same. |

## What looks good

- The three producers in `crates/sim/src/verify/solid.rs` (lines 220, 231, 236) emit `RapidInPart`. The stock laws keep `RapidInStock` and its message.
- `RapidInPart` blocks the post (`blocks_post`). A pin asserts this.
- The exhaustive consumers have the new kind: MCP `rapid_in_part`, `warned_moves`, and the two matches of the UI fold.
- The stock acquittals (`prior`, `prior_traverse`, `stock_top`, `traverse_solids`, `fine_bore::acquit`, `turning_rapids`, `clearance_stock`) match `RapidInStock` only. Thus none of them can remove a part finding. The change is in the safe direction.
- The diff changes no `*.nc` file, no `*.cl` file, no file in `examples/catalog/`, no fixture and no snapshot PNG. There are no moved goldens to check.
- The diff changes no `Cargo.toml`, `build.rs`, script, workflow or process file.
- The decision record `docs/decisions/3520-rapid-part-message.md` is in the PR. The body has `Changelog:` and ends with `Fixes #3520`.

## Results merged with main

All commands ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3777`. No GitHub runner ran.
The trial merge is `dfeffcda3`. Its first parent is the PR head `e1bbe8583`. Its second parent is `upstream/main` at `146145a42`. The merge had no conflict.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | green: 411 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled |
| `cargo xtask gate light` | green: 6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --test posed_rapids` | 9 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --only "app heavy: flute_reach"` | green: 1 step, 0 failed |

Extra suites run (each is a green step of the quick gate above):

- `app suites: example_catalog`, `example_catalog_adaptive`, `example_catalog_edge_work`
- `app suites: first_part_programs`, `first_router_part`, `solid_law_goldens`
- `app suites: rotary_verify`, `mark_floor`, `warned_moves`, `lib`
- `sim suites: lib`, `posed_rapids`, `mark_retract`
- `motion suites: solid_law`
- `ui suites: lib`

The diff changes no file in `testdata/` and no import code. Thus the test-data rule and the importer rule do not apply.

Heavy lanes: I did not run the full heavy lanes again. The author's record names this head: "`cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: 99 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled" on `e1bbe8583`, base `db3bb1f7f` (https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3777#issuecomment-7119177978). That base is less than 24 hours old. The commits of `main` after that base change a waterline ring file and the Machines pane. They do not touch the warning kinds. I ran the one heavy step whose test this diff edits (`flute_reach`), and it is green.

## Mutations run by this reviewer

I applied each mutation alone and restored the source after each run. The worktree is clean.

| Mutation | Result | Restored |
|---|---|---|
| `solid.rs:236` (general rapid) back to `RapidInStock` | Red: `a_vertical_part_rapid_names_the_part_and_move` and the two ledge tests | Green |
| `solid.rs:231` (retract edge column) back to `RapidInStock` | Red: `a_stack_retract_edge_column_names_the_part_and_move` | Green |
| `RapidInPart` added to the advisory list of `blocks_post` (`types.rs:449`) | Red: three `part_message` pins, "a rapid into the part must hold the post" | Green |

## Requested before merge

None.

## Follow-ups (file after merge)

These items are not blockers. They are in code that the earlier review read, or outside the scope of #3520.

1. `crates/app/src/operation/thread_boss.rs:307` (suggested `P7`). The neighbour law of an external Thread emits `RapidInStock` when a rapid meets a wall of the part. That contact gets the stock message. #3520 asks only for the part-solid law, thus this is new work.
2. `crates/app/src/operation/mark_law.rs:205` and `crates/sim/src/verify/solid.rs:140` (suggested `P7`). The two doc comments still name `RapidInStock` for a result that is now `RapidInPart`.

## Notes (not blocking)

- A rapid that the part law and the stock law convict now has two findings, one of each kind. Before this PR it had two `RapidInStock` findings in `verify`, or one after the dedupe in `contain_into`. The UI shows them as two lines.
- The stock acquittals no longer remove a part finding on the same move. This is stricter than before. The catalog and golden suites show no changed verdict.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
